summary: xAI announced that its Grok 4.6 coding model is now available as a selectable model in GitHub Copilot (VS Code, cloud agents, Copilot CLI), alongside API pricing of $2/$6 per million input/output tokens.

mechanisms.reason: Distributing the model into a high-volume developer surface like GitHub Copilot expands the pool of calls it can serve.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for the millions of developers who work in VS Code and across GitHub every day.

categories.reason: The announcement is specifically about model distribution through the GitHub Copilot platform, making the platform relationship the substance of the story.

practices.reason: Teams using GitHub Copilot can now select Grok 4.6 from the model picker, a concrete, actionable integration change.
practices.quote: Open the model picker and select "Grok 4.6" to start using our latest coding model. Some businesses and enterprises will need to enable the model from Copilot settings.
